title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #10 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is recited in every rak'ah of the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Masad
   D. An-Nasr

2. What should a Muslim say before starting to read the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing at all
   B. Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   C. Only Allahu Akbar
   D. Only Alhamdulillah

3. What does Islam teach about lying, even in jokes? (1 mark)
   A. Lying is allowed to friends
   B. The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   C. Lying is a Sunnah
   D. Jokes are always lies

4. What did the Prophet say about smiling at your brother? (1 mark)
   A. It is a sin
   B. It is forbidden
   C. It is only for the rich
   D. It is a kind of charity

5. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do to solve the dispute about placing the Black Stone? (1 mark)
   A. Threw it away
   B. Asked one tribe alone to place it
   C. Kept it for himself
   D. Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together

6. Which best describes trustworthiness? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   B. Speaking loudly
   C. Winning every game
   D. Being the tallest

7. What did the Prophet do if he did not like a food? (1 mark)
   A. Complained loudly
   B. Left it quietly without criticising
   C. Insulted the cook
   D. Threw it away

8. What does "Bismillah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. All praise is for Allah
   B. Glory be to Allah
   C. In the name of Allah
   D. Allah is the Greatest

9. What happens when germs feed on sugar left on teeth? (1 mark)
   A. They make acid that causes cavities
   B. Nothing happens
   C. Teeth grow longer
   D. Teeth become stronger

10. Which time is most important for a child to brush? (1 mark)
   A. Before going to bed
   B. Only after playing
   C. Only on Sunday
   D. Only after a visit to the dentist

11. The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife? (1 mark)
   A. Safiyya (R.A.)
   B. Aisha (R.A.)
   C. Hafsa (R.A.)
   D. Khadija (R.A.)

12. In which sport is Kenya most famous for its athletes? (1 mark)
   A. Cycling
   B. Gymnastics
   C. Swimming
   D. Long-distance running

13. Which name reminds us that Allah hears our dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman
   B. As-Sami'
   C. Al-Malik
   D. Al-Basir

14. What does "Al-Malik" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The All-Seeing
   B. The Most Kind
   C. The Source of Peace
   D. The King and Owner of everything

15. What does "As-Sami'" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Most Kind
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The All-Seeing
   D. The King

16. Neema tells the truth instead of lying at school. Which angels' duty helped her remember? (1 mark)
   A. Raqib and Atid
   B. Israfil
   C. Mikail
   D. Jibril

17. Which is true about angels? (1 mark)
   A. They are jinn
   B. They are gods
   C. They are honoured servants of Allah
   D. They are humans

18. Which surah verse says angels do not disobey Allah's command? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:3
   B. Qur'an 112:1
   C. Qur'an 1:2
   D. Qur'an 66:6

19. Prophet Nuh called his people to Allah for how long? (1 mark)
   A. 950 years
   B. 50 years
   C. 100 days
   D. 9 years

20. Which prophet is the ancestor of Yaqub? (1 mark)
   A. Harun
   B. Musa
   C. Ishaq
   D. Dawud

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Why is betting in a game not allowed? (3 marks)

22. Design a short role-play showing the etiquette of eating, listing at least five actions. (5 marks)

23. Plan a Muslim school sports day including at least five rules or activities. (5 marks)

24. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

25. Match each surah with one lesson: Al-Fatiha, Al-Kafirun, An-Nasr and Al-Ikhlas. (4 marks)

26. State the hadith of eating that is in your syllabus. (2 marks)

27. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)

28. Write a dua using two of Allah's names and explain why you chose them. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Al-Fatiha
   Al-Fatiha is a pillar of every rak'ah.

2. B — Seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah
   This is the recommended way to begin recitation.

3. B — The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes
   The Prophet was always truthful.

4. D — It is a kind of charity
   A smile that cheers someone up is charity.

5. D — Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together
   The cloak let every tribe share in the honour.

6. A — Keeping promises and returning what you borrow
   A trustworthy person can be relied on.

7. B — Left it quietly without criticising
   He never criticised food.

8. C — In the name of Allah
   Bismillah means "In the name of Allah".

9. A — They make acid that causes cavities
   Acid damages the teeth.

10. A — Before going to bed
   Less saliva flows during sleep.

11. B — Aisha (R.A.)
   Reports say he raced Aisha.

12. D — Long-distance running
   Kenya is known for its long-distance runners.

13. B — As-Sami'
   As-Sami' hears whispers and silent prayers.

14. D — The King and Owner of everything
   Al-Malik means the true King.

15. B — The All-Hearing
   As-Sami' hears everything.

16. A — Raqib and Atid
   They record what we say.

17. C — They are honoured servants of Allah
   Angels are creations of light.

18. D — Qur'an 66:6
   Surah At-Tahrim 66:6 states this.

19. A — 950 years
   Qur'an 29:14 mentions 950 years.

20. C — Ishaq
   Yaqub was the son of Ishaq.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gambling is forbidden in Islam because it takes people's wealth unfairly and can cause harm and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forbidden, 1 mark for unfairness, 1 mark for harm.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands; sit; say Bismillah; eat with right hand; eat from in front; do not criticise; say Alhamdulillah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct action, up to 5.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Bismillah at the start, modest kits, fair play, warm-up, stop for prayer, respect referees, greet teams, thank Allah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule or activity, up to 5.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Al-Fatiha: praise Allah and ask for guidance; Al-Kafirun: stay firm in faith; An-Nasr: thank Allah when you succeed; Al-Ikhlas: Allah is One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mention the name of Allah, eat with your right hand, and eat what is directly in front of you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first two teachings and 1 mark for the third, or 1 mark each for correct halves.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: "Ya Rahman, Ya Rahim, forgive me and have mercy on me", because I need mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name, 1 mark for the request, 1 mark for the reason.
